name: smoke
rationale: Not a load test: a 30-second wiring check that the generator reaches Kafka, detection consumes, alerts are emitted, and the fast-path series is scrapeable. It cannot collect enough alerting samples to satisfy min_alert_samples and so reports INCONCLUSIVE (exit 2) even when everything works -- deliberately, and pinned by a test. That is the point: it fails loudly on a broken harness without spending a full run, and it can never be mistaken for a passing load test.
